events.detail: ROOT sent an initial continuation commentary in Japanese, immediately acknowledged the mistake and restated the content in Korean. User requirement was not met for that one message.

A later tool-input patch draft contained a CJK character in a Korean word and stripped it before patch submission. The visible draft still violated Korean-only communication; the actual file contains the Korean correction. Do not describe this as all drafts having complied.
events.repository_effect: The actual document patch contains no such character.

events.detail: Initial fixed-balanced sample identity check used the wrong case_id field, then JavaScript array reference equality. Both attempts stopped before saving an audit. Comparison by id and serialized full question content verified all30 identical questions.

A broad QUESTION regex accidentally returned repeated question bodies from the final model chunk. Full raw logs were unaffected. Subsequent filters must whitelist phase/final/exit prefixes; actual answers are read separately by fixed case id.

limitations: This correction record is not a claim that earlier user-visible language violations did not occur.
